header.headline: Curious mind. Creative soul. Code in hand.
header.intro: Hello! I'm Abdullah Al Maksud, a passionate Full-Stack Developer, UI/UX Designer, and Author based in Bangladesh. I love turning complex ideas into elegant, blazing-fast, and meaningful digital experiences.
header.subIntro: Whether building high-performance web systems with Next.js, designing pixel-perfect interfaces with meticulous attention to detail, or writing books and articles that spark curiosity—I care deeply about craftsmanship, usability, and impact.

pillars.title: Web & App Engineering
pillars.description: Building scalable, high-performance web applications and mobile apps with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern backend APIs.

pillars.title: UI/UX & Design Systems
pillars.description: Crafting cohesive visual identities, responsive design systems, and delightful interfaces with rich micro-animations and micro-interactions.

pillars.title: Writing & Authorship
pillars.description: Author of popular science book 'What If (Emon Jodi Hoto)' and deep-dive technical essays on software craft, developer productivity, and mindset.

pillars.title: Developer Tooling & Systems
pillars.description: Creating intuitive utilities, open-source developer toolkits, and productivity suites that streamline engineers' workflows.

experience.description: Architecting scalable web applications, modern developer tooling suites (DevTools), and creating high-impact visual design identities with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
highlights: Architecting full-stack digital products with modular architecture and high-performance server components.
Building developer productivity tools and intuitive web utilities with seamless UX.
Creating custom UI/UX design systems with fluid dark/light themes and responsive micro-animations.

experience.description: Authored and published the acclaimed popular science and curiosity book 'What If (Emon Jodi Hoto)', breaking down astrophysics, physics thought experiments, and scientific queries for readers.

Authored educational essays on software craftsmanship, engineering mindset, and modern web architectures.
Conducted reader engagement sessions and science communication discussions.

experience.description: Engineered robust web and mobile applications with React, React Native, and Node.js for startups and business clients across various industries.

Built responsive client portals and dashboards with React, Redux, and RESTful API integrations.
Optimized client websites for Core Web Vitals, achieving 40%+ faster initial load times and improved SEO.

experience.description: Focused on creating responsive user interfaces, brand identities, marketing graphics, and landing pages for local businesses and creative startups.
highlights: Crafted 25+ brand identities, typography guidelines, and marketing visual assets.
Implemented pixel-perfect responsive HTML5/CSS3 and JavaScript interfaces from design prototypes.
Collaborated with product teams to refine user workflows and enhance visual presentation.
